contract.rule: Pass this object—and only this object—to downstream inference.

customer_message.body:
Good afternoon

Given the unusual circumstance: We think we ventilate enough; The caretaker says the wardrobe is directly against the exterior wall; my partner says the gap is about ten centimetres; We logged humidity on only four evenings; this order reflects what I know.

Regarding “mold behind furniture with disputed ventilation and use patterns”, for an initial view: the ventilation frequency remains unresolved; for the request “organize the conflicting accounts and arrange a neutral indoor-climate and building inspection”: I currently have only part of the records; on “mold behind furniture with disputed ventilation and use patterns”, I feel stressed but will not rush; also unresolved: the furniture clearance; I need a professional view on that.

I am asking for: organize the conflicting accounts and arrange a neutral indoor-climate and building inspection; in particular, I need clarity about the furniture clearance and how the exceptional circumstance changes the route.

I became aware of the problem on 07 January 2025.

Thank you for reviewing carefully; Please explain the ventilation frequency; That will let me complete my records.

Best regards
customer_message.subject: Request for a detailed review: mold behind furniture with disputed ventilation and use patterns
